note: THE DOCUMENT REGISTRY. Greg, S112: 'we need to put the list of our working docs in the store or a section of the sop so one doesn't get forgotten about.' Same disease as A-17 one level up - a document that is on no list goes stale silently, and nothing can report it. MEASURED THE DAY THIS WAS BUILT: 55 of 151 tracked research/kalshi/*.py files were absent from KALSHI_TRADING.md, the index whose stated job is 'every Kalshi file, what it does, current vs old'; and PLANT_MAP.md had been EDITED THAT SAME SESSION while naming none of the four plant components built in it. So mtime is not staleness - CONTENT is, and only a content gate catches this.

classes.LIVE: must be kept current. A gate exists where the content can be computed; otherwise the trigger is stated and the andon can only remind.
classes.RENDER: GENERATED from a store. Never hand-edit - edit the store and re-render. Gated byte-identical by store.py check.
classes.VAULT: frozen, sha256-manifested. A change is a versioned vault event on Greg's go, never an edit. Gated by verify_gold.py.
classes.RECORD: dated and finished. NEVER updated - a handoff, kickoff, drop-in, ledger or findings memo describes the session that wrote it. Editing one is falsifying the record.
classes.ARCHIVE: moved out of the live surface deliberately. Consulted, not maintained.
classes.EXTERNAL: a DELIVERED HAND-OFF from outside the session - a ChatGPT brief, a research vendor deliverable, a task packet we sent out and got back. It is a RECORD (dated, never edited) that additionally carries RECOMMENDATIONS, so D36 binds: every numbered recommendation gets a registry id in the session the document lands, INCLUDING the ones we decide against. Audited via store/briefing_audits.json; station0/briefings reports it.

close_out_trio.note: Greg, S112: 'update all of our docs other than the 3 ending ones.' These three are written LAST, at close-out, because they summarise everything else. They are excluded from mid-session doc sweeps by design. S112 addition (Greg: 'include a doc that i can download and send to chat along with the drop ins when you're printing'): the ChatGPT hand-off ships WITH the drop-in and is GENERATED from the registry by chatgpt_handoff.py, so a finished item cannot appear in it as a live request - A-9's rule, one document over.
